request_body.raw_goal: Stay connected to my professional field — maybe one small freelance article or project per month. Nothing too intense.
request_body.user_context: New mother, baby is 4 months old. On extended leave from marketing job, doing some part-time freelance from home. Very fragmented time. Does not want guilt if she misses days. Wants to feel like herself again, not hit KPIs.

proposed_milestones.description: Finalize and release one monthly professional deliverable.

objectives: Re-establish awareness of deep core and pelvic floor engagement to stabilize the trunk.
Gradually reintegrate functional movement patterns that support daily caregiving demands.

Practice gentle, isolated pelvic floor contractions to improve muscular endurance and awareness.

Practice bracing techniques while performing common household tasks like lifting the baby or laundry.

Assess tolerance for increased range of motion without compensating through lumbar hyper-extension.

success_metrics: Ability to perform sustained diaphragmatic breathing for 5 minutes without discomfort.
Noticeable reduction in perceived lower back or pelvic tension during daily infant-care activities.
Ability to complete a 15-minute sequence of movement without experiencing significant fatigue or compensatory postural shifts.
